name: Semiaquatic Circus
source:
Do you like yourself?

Would it be better if you changed?

Capella isn't so sure of the answer herself.  But she's hoping she can find out,  if she takes a chance and joins the circus. Will she find the answer she's looking for? Or will a one-way ticket to clown town be more than she bargained for?

[from [url=https://arcadekitten.itch.io/semiaquatic-circus]itch.io[/url]]
